what: A six-page brief for Professor Alberto Grando (22 Nov 2026): the survey he shared, what zhol is, the radar at work, one ask for introductions, thank you. Built from the Workshop 3 deck (deck/ holds its slides and CSS; /_blob ids are the deck's assets, rendered by the deck's PDF script). The PDF itself is personal and lives in outreach/private/briefs/ (git-ignored).
pages: bcover: the milestone cover scene, addressed to him
overview: from fog to a clear view of the project
results: the survey's four findings, who answered, what holds an office back
radar: the live map and what it predicted
ask: could you connect us, the fork-in-the-road scene
farewell: thank you, QR to zhol.live

envelope-stacks.webp.scene: transparent except the bottom-right: a warehouse loading dock grows from the right and bottom edges; five stacks of envelopes of different heights stand like a bar chart; Zholdas kneels and adds one more, looking at the stack; a mailbag beside him; the back of a truck trailer at the right edge. New scene type: answers as a bar chart of envelopes.

reused: cover, overview band, radar map, fork and farewell scenes from design/deck-workshop3 (the brief is an excerpt of that deck)
